name: The Crown of Zero
story: Beyond the roofless shelter, another palace blocks the way to the water.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: They meet at the roofless shelter. Beyond it, water sounds behind a familiar palace.

beforeStory.speaker: Zero King
beforeStory.text: Stay. One more duel. She may pass without you.

beforeStory.speaker: The Long Road
beforeStory.text: Arith stays beside Mara. When she steps toward the door, he steps with her.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The echoes fall silent. The King lifts his hand toward himself, then pauses.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: Arith lowers his own hand. For a moment, neither moves.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: The King steps aside. Beyond the door is a small ferry, and a white bench with one end repaired.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I thought I would know when I arrived. But this place has not remembered everything for me.

afterStory.speaker: The Long Road
afterStory.text: A boat comes alongside. Mara picks up her coat from the empty seat.

afterStory.speaker: Mara Venn
afterStory.text: I can wait a little. But today I do not have to wait until someone comes. Are you coming?

pages.speaker: The Long Road
pages.text: Arith steps into the boat. Mara makes room beside her.

pages.speaker: Mara Venn
pages.text: Do you know where it goes?

pages.speaker: The Long Road
pages.text: The waterskin rests between them. Along the shore, the white bench grows small.

pages.speaker: The Long Road
pages.text: Arith stays by the mooring post. He looks back along the road.

pages.speaker: Mara Venn
pages.text: Come back when you want to. Not just because I asked.

pages.speaker: The Long Road
pages.text: The boat leaves. Near the roofless shelter, Arith meets a traveller who has stopped walking.

pages.speaker: The Long Road
pages.text: He makes room on the bench. After a while, the traveller sits beside him.
